'''Aut-O''' was a [[Super tactical droid/Legends|super tactical droid]] who commanded a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] made up mainly of [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]] and one [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]]. His fleet was infiltrated by the [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]], who stole the Confederacy's [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]]. He was decapitated by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].

==Biography==
[[File:Aut-0_Command_Bridge.jpg|thumb|left|275px|Aut-O on the bridge of his flagship.]]
Aut-O was in command of a Separatist fleet in Separatist territory. His [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] carried an [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]] that was needed to decipher a coded transmission sent out by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to his allies. While in a Confederate shuttle, the [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] infiltrated [[Aut-O's flagship/Legends|Aut-O's flagship]] and made their way to [[C-Deck/Legends|C-Deck]], the ship's communication center. After multiple energy fluctuations, Aut-O decided to investigate the phenomenons himself. When he discovered the D-Squad attempting to retrieve the encryption module, he held [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] at blaster-point. However, the little astromech acted quickly by deactivating the artificial gravity in the room, causing all the droids to float helplessly around.

Aut-O tried to stop the intruders any way he could as his escort had been already destroyed by the Republic droids. Alone, Aut-O was struggling with stopping R2 from getting the module and trying to eliminate [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]]. Aut-O was holding tight to R2's legs while the astromech proceeded to melt Aut-O's hands with its boosters. Aut-O was then distracted by Gascon who started kicking the droid in the optical sensors. Aut-O managed to shake his head and get rid off Gascon temporarily. Unfortunately, Gascon managed to jump back at Aut-O and the Super tactacal droid opened fire at the pesky [[Zilkin/Legends|Zilkin]]. Gascon grabbed on to Aut-O's blaster, making Aut-O start shaking his blaster and shooting at the same time all over the place. While trying to get rid off Gascon once more, Aut-O was hit out of nowhere by [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]] holding a droid leg. Aut-O struck back and knocked down WAC while the pit droid was paying attention to Gascon. With WAC out of the way, Aut-O continued to pull down R2 who had gotten to the module. Aut-O tried at the same time to pull down the astromech and swat Gascon who was nearby.

[[File:Aut-O_head.png|thumb|right|275px|Aut-O's decapitated head.]]

In the end, WAC-47 had regained contentiousness and activated the gravity that was previously shut off. Aut-O fell, then proceeded to crush Gascon. R2-D2 witnessed this and purposely fell onto Aut-O's head, effectively decapitating the Super tactical droid.Yet, after Aut-O's death, he sent out a distress signal which triggered an alarm. But to no avail, as the droids reporting to C-Deck accidentally mistook the D-Squad as crew members.

==Behind the scenes==
Aut-O was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]] who voices the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.
